records.claim: Project Marinus marked the start of its next construction phase, with construction activities ramping up across Tasmania and Victoria after financial close and major approvals; Stage 1 provides a 750 MW two-way interconnector.
records.observation: A financed and approved interconnector is moving into physical construction rather than remaining a future network option.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA in project stage. The 750 MW transfer capacity is not yet operational and is targeted for service by 2030.

records.claim: S&P Global counted 19 September LNG shipments through Hormuz and Kpler counted 21, up from 15 in June; some Qatar-linked vessels continued dark transits with AIS switched off.
records.observation: LNG flow through the chokepoint has recovered materially while abnormal navigation and security conditions persist.
records.assessment: PERSISTENT / ADAPTING. Stronger throughput does not establish route normalisation and is not promoted to a fresh delta.

records.claim: European governments discussed a French proposal to release 50 million barrels of diesel from strategic stocks alongside discussion of an additional 50 million barrels of crude among IEA members.
records.observation: Pressure is shifting toward refined-product buffers as diesel supply remains tight.
records.assessment: DEVELOPING. A proposed stock release is not counted as physical supply until a decision and execution occur.

records.claim: Gas Malaysia targets a final investment decision in the second half of 2027 for a Kedah LNG import terminal of up to 6 mtpa, with completion targeted around 2030.
records.observation: Northern Malaysia is developing an alternative import route and supplier option, but capital commitment has not yet reached FID.
records.assessment: DEVELOPING. The terminal is an infrastructure option, not committed operating capacity.
